parameters.query: SELECT c.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type LIKE 'nurture_%') as nurture_step FROM contacts c WHERE c.lead_status IN ('new', 'contacted') AND c.lead_score BETWEEN 20 AND 70 AND c.created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type LIKE 'nurture_%' AND la.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '5 days' ) ORDER BY c.lead_score DESC LIMIT 50

INSERT INTO lead_activities (contact_id, activity_type, activity_data, score_impact) VALUES ({{ $json.id }}, 'nurture_email_sent', '{"step": {{ $json.nurture_step }}, "template": "{{ $json.template_id }}", "content_type": "{{ $json.content_type }}"}', 3); UPDATE contacts SET lead_score = lead_score + 3 WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};
UPDATE contacts SET lead_status = 'qualified' WHERE id = {{ $json.id }} AND lead_status != 'qualified'
